state: All u64 triples paired with Result<u64,ZeroModulus> observations.
forward: For m=0 return Err(ZeroModulus). Otherwise return Ok(r), 0<=r<m, r congruent to base^exponent modulo m. Exponent zero means identity including 0^0; m=1 always returns zero.
inverse: U consists of all input triples paired with Err or Ok(u64). U minus R contains Ok when m=0, Err when m>0, and Ok(r) with m>0 but r>=m or wrong power congruence. Exact mathematical target, bounded-tested.

Err admits exactly m=0 triples. Ok(r) admits all triples with m>r and b^e congruent to r mod m. Different bases/exponents/moduli retain ambiguity; e=0 restricts r=1%m and m=1 permits all b,e with r=0.
cost: At most 64 bit iterations, O(1+log(exponent+1)) modular operations and O(1) space. Zero modulus exits before remainder. No timing claim.
checks: External compiled mutant rejected by exact single-test filter
limitations: Partial syntax omits expanded macros and semantic analysis; finite tests do not prove all inputs.
